practice.title: Worked examples: CPU Profiling
steps: Collect 5 representative CPU Profiling problems from an authoritative source.
Work each one using the standard tooling for this field and your note-taking system, recording assumptions and results.
Compare with the reference answer and write one line on every difference.
practice.description: A self-contained exercise on CPU Profiling for Performance Engineering. Finish it by checking that an independent reader follows the steps and reaches the same result.

projects.title: Mini-project: apply CPU Profiling
projects.description: Apply CPU Profiling for Performance Engineering and produce a documented worked example whose steps someone else can reproduce. Then check that an independent reader follows the steps and reaches the same result.
projects.goal: Demonstrate working command of CPU Profiling by producing a documented worked example whose steps someone else can reproduce and verifying that an independent reader follows the steps and reaches the same result.
requirements: A documented worked example whose steps someone else can reproduce that genuinely applies CPU Profiling for Performance Engineering.
Record the inputs, assumptions, and exact steps you followed.
State the evidence that it works: an independent reader follows the steps and reaches the same result.
outcomes: Working the documentation plus the working artifact.
A short written explanation of CPU Profiling you could defend in a review or interview.
extensions: Re-do it under one changed constraint (scale, tolerance, budget, or dataset) and compare the outcome.
